description: Prerequisite: Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style. Tips: - Be ready for a tough fight; bring some healing items. Reward: - N/A

title: 52 - Be My Boyfriend!
description: Prerequisite: Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style. Tips: - Rewards vary based on your answers. The best answers are as follows: - "Pleased to meet you sir. I'm Goro Majima." - "I'm a dentist." - "We sat next to each other at a movie." - "She's so innocent and childlike." Reward: - Sprite Belt (accessory) - for four best answers chosen - Fluorite x5 (crafting material) - for two or three best answers chosen - Bulletproof Glass Amulet (accessory) - for one best answer chosen

title: 53 - Man with a Stranger's Face
description: Prerequisite: Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style. Reward: - Sakura Storm (weapon)

title: 54 - Disciple of the New Order
description: Prerequisite: Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style. Tips: - To avoid an extra fight, choose the correct actions & words: - "I want to join the Order of Munan Chohept Onast" - Call her Iori - Say it with the pose - "Onast" - "Shooreh Pippi" - "Circle with the Left Hand, Then Bring Palms Together" - "Munan Suzuki" Reward: - Crystal (crafting material) - if you got the answers right - Traveler's Amulet (accessory)

title: 55 - Calling the Future
description: Prerequisite: Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style, then use the [Save Point](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-0/maps/sotenbori?locationIds=939766) Tips: - Batteries can be purchased from [Don Quijote Sotenbori](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-0/maps/sotenbori?locationIds=939821) Reward: - New [Save Point](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-0/maps/sotenbori?locationIds=939825) available

title: 56 - A Taxing Issue
description: Prerequisite: Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style Tips: - Rewards vary based on your answers. The best answers are as follows: - "To provide public services" - "Tobacco" - "Gasoline" - "8%" Reward: - Primeval Spirit Stone (accessory) - for picking the best answers

title: 57 - Crossed Words
description: Prerequisite: Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style Tips: - Rewards vary based on your answers. The best answers are as follows: - "Mashed" - "Popcorn" - "Shoulder" - "Soy sauce" Reward: - Pearl x3 (crafting material) - for choosing the correct answers - Quality Iron (crafting material) - for choosing the wrong answers

title: 79 - Komian's Chef

Tips: - To progress your friendship with the chef after this substory, purchase food and prepare to fish up an Eel, Turtle, and Salmon. Reward: - Trouble Finder (accessory) - after reaching maximum friendship level

title: 81 - Gandhara's Clerk
description: Prerequisite: Progress the story until you've unlocked the Slugger fighting style, then watch any video at [Gandhara Sotenbori](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-0/maps/sotenbori?locationIds=939874) Tips: - To progress your friendship with the clerk after this substory, watch more videos. Reward: - After reaching maximum friendship level and unlocking the cabaret minigame, speak to the clerk to partner with [Gandhara](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-0/maps/sotenbori?locationIds=939720).

title: 82 - Kyoko at SEGA HI-TECH LAND

Reward: - After reaching maximum friendship level and unlocking the cabaret minigame, speak to Kyoko to partner with [SEGA Hi-Tech Land](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-0/maps/sotenbori?locationIds=939792).
